intro: Darkhorn the Elder is a seasonal quest completed by seeking out Elder Darkhorn in Orgrimmar during the Lunar Festival. Travelers pay their respects to the honored ancestor, receiving a token of wisdom and celebration in return. She stands in the heart of the Horde capital as a testament to age, survival, and ancestral pride.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your spirit burns with life, young adventurer. I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token...
